description: This PHP class defines a value formatter for formatting passport types based on employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. It implements a specific interface to provide formatted string values from entity data, specifically mapping document types to their display names.

classes.name: FormatWithPassportType
classes.description: A class that implements the ValueFormatter interface to convert immigration record entity values into human-readable passport type strings.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted passport type string corresponding to the given entity value, or null if no mapping exists.
